# spec/gates/cite

`spec/gates/cite` — what the gates that read a contract's sources share:
reading them once a run, finding the section a citation names, and naming
a citation in a message ("RFC §2.2" in the main RFC, "rfc2104 §2" in
another source).

Generated from [src/spec/gates/cite.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/gates/cite.ts).

## Declarations

### gateSources

The contract's sources, read on the first call of a run. The call that
reads them reports each source that could not be read, under its gate, so
that nothing citing it passes unchecked unnoticed.

```ts
function gateSources(ctx: CheckContext, out: string[], gate: string): SourceSet
```

<scalar-field name="ctx" type="CheckContext" required>

the check's context

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="out" type="string[]" required>

the calling gate's findings

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="gate" type="string" required>

the calling gate's name

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="SourceSet">

the sources read

</scalar-field>

### gateCitedSection

The section a citation names. A source that was not read gives null
silently (gateSources reported it); a section its source lacks is a
finding.

```ts
function gateCitedSection(
  ctx: CheckContext,
  out: string[],
  gate: string,
  source: string | null,
  section: string,
  at: string,
): RfcSection | null
```

<scalar-field name="ctx" type="CheckContext" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="out" type="string[]" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="gate" type="string" required>

the gate's name

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="source" type="string | null" required>

the source the citation names; null for the main one

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="section" type="string" required>

the section it names

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="at" type="string" required>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="RfcSection | null">

the section, or null

</scalar-field>

### gateQuoteWhole

Whether a quote is printed in a text as whole words somewhere: at some
occurrence, neither its first character nor its last continues a word of
the text around it. "MUST" inside "MUSTARD", "LEN" inside "K_LEN",
"5" cut from "1.5", or "ust not" cut from "must not", is not a quote of
the text.

```ts
function gateQuoteWhole(text: string, q: string): boolean
```

<scalar-field name="text" type="string" required>

the text, whitespace collapsed

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="q" type="string" required>

the quote, whitespace collapsed

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="boolean">

true when some occurrence is word-bounded; false for an empty quote, which quotes nothing

</scalar-field>

### gateQuoteMissing

Why a quote is not in a section, verbatim with whitespace collapsed:
empty, holding text a reader cannot see, not printed there, or printed
only as part of a word.

```ts
function gateQuoteMissing(sec: RfcSection, quote: string): string | null
```

<scalar-field name="sec" type="RfcSection" required>

the section

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="quote" type="string" required>

the quote

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string | null">

the reason, or null when the section prints it

</scalar-field>

### gateArgsAt

Where a vector's args are printed: its cited section, or its `section`
when a command or the spec vouches for its result, in the source
`sectionSource` names (the main one when it names none).

```ts

```
